subject.title: [Feature]: Ali bailian coding plan support ( thinking/reasoning enabled )

question: What official support boundary should OpenClaw use for Ali Bailian/Qwen Coding Plan reasoning: custom-provider compat only, bundled catalog entries, or both?
rationale: The remaining work changes provider/model capability defaults for existing Bailian/Qwen users and depends on vendor endpoint-specific proof, so automation should not choose the permanent support boundary alone.

options.title: Support both proven paths
options.body: Review the custom-provider inference and bundled catalog PRs as complementary slices, but require live endpoint proof and tests before merging either.

options.title: Limit to custom provider configs
options.body: Keep bundled Coding Plan catalog entries conservative and document a verified custom-provider configuration for users who can prove reasoning support.

options.title: Defer bundled reasoning support
options.body: Leave the issue open until maintainers or contributors can provide current vendor proof for each Coding Plan model and region.

recommendation.title: Support both proven paths
recommendation.body: Review the custom-provider inference and bundled catalog PRs as complementary slices, but require live endpoint proof and tests before merging either.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced and reviewed adjacent Qwen reasoning/provider work and already routed this issue's remaining support boundary in the discussion.
